verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows Conductor exposing a hosted MCP *server* so external clients (ChatGPT, Claude, Codex) can manage Conductor's cloud workspaces — the opposite direction of the story, which asks whether users can plug external MCP servers into Conductor so it can consume their tools. No evidence describes Conductor acting as an MCP client or letting users configure/attach third-party MCP servers for its own agent sessions.
